title: Why Does a Flashlight Turn On When You Click It? #Shorts
description:
Blue wants to know what a click actually does. Orange explains the loop: batteries nose to tail, a spring at the tail, a metal strip back to the switch, and a tiny gap your click closes. Plus why yours flickers when you shake it (rusty contacts) and the pencil eraser fix.

Explained in 60, podcast edition
